_comment: GENERATED by `python -m simulator.e3_grid --refresh-signals` — the frozen closed-book belief signals E3's price grid is derived from. Same snapshot simulator/e3_signals.py hands every baseline. Each model_uncertainty is a mean over the E1-matched draws recorded in "precompute" below.

precompute.aggregation: arithmetic mean over draws, per signal; draws where a signal is absent or None are skipped (see n_draws_by_signal)
precompute.tracker_note: one temperature-0.0 extraction, matching llm/experiment1/run.py's per-question tracker cache; not averaged
